card.name: Linking words before treatment-phase timing
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, during, after and for that come right before a treatment phase or time span. They appear in dosing and monitoring schedules, e.g. 'completion of induction' or 'weekly during the first month'.

modes.label: Of/after before a phase
modes.description: A linking word follows a completion or end point and precedes a treatment phase like induction or parenteral therapy.
modes.example: at the end<< of>> induction. Continue ICLUSIG in combination

modes.label: During before a period
modes.description: The word 'during' introduces the period in which monitoring is repeated.
modes.example: every 2 weeks<< during>> the first 3 months of treatment,

modes.label: For before a duration
modes.description: A linking word comes right before a length of time for a dose.
modes.example: daily doses of 160 mg of methylprednisolone<< for>> a week followed by 64 mg

card.writes: It suppresses words like lifelong, permanent and lifetime, which steers the next words away from permanence and toward a limited treatment period.
card.plain: It marks small words that lead into a time window of treatment, like 'during induction' or 'after 5-10 days'.
